scope: First complete eight-scene stock manga OCR baseline from the frozen V6 product artifact. Earlier interrupted harness attempts are retained separately. Exact original source and all failures are retained; this is not a candidate quality pass.
commitBinding: Root-controlled stock V6 artifact for head 43f991. Its archive was produced on c302 with uncommitted V6 changes; the five recorded product modules match 43f991 exactly and all 515 compiled file hashes were rechecked. This archival step does not rebuild or assert a clean 43f991 build.
runnerArchiveLimitation: The native stock run did not archive its runner source hash. It included actual-response no-bitmap/wordless handling and preceded the later initial/cache source-visibility helper. No present runner hash is assigned to this historical run.

productFreeze.fileMapDigestAlgorithm: SHA256 of UTF8 compact JSON object {relativePath:SHA256}, keys sorted by JavaScript UTF16 code units, no final newline.

limitations: Discovery attaches Offscreen after its creation; events emitted before Runtime.enable cannot be guaranteed.
Existing dedicated workers are attached when discovered; new children are paused only after their Offscreen owner has enabled auto-attach.
This observer covers this isolated extension Offscreen and dedicated/shared worker targets; it does not prove every iframe or browser API failure was emitted as Runtime/Log.
Worker Log domain can be unavailable; Runtime warning/error/exception collection remains mandatory.
Duplicate forwarded known-placement logs are associated only when one worker console event has the identical full timestamp-bearing message and complete stack; raw observations remain in rawEntries.
Third-party placement advisories are non-blocking only after the independent functional script reports success; this does not measure GPU coverage or claim every operation used the preferred backend.
14/23 source anchors and 3/8 strict scenes are distinct counts, not CER. Five scenes retain missing colored dialogue or a missing colored tail.

8 declared wordless regions have 0 detections; protected opaque pixels, source restore and cached redisplay checks passed on all 8 scenes. This does not establish absence of all artwork false positives or full original-text removal.
The native stock artifact has no SDK observer patch. Offscreen pipeline samples do not count native inference inside its separate worker; runs:0 is not zero model inference.
The unchanged numeric time 08:45 legitimately completes with empty manga patches; the wordless page returns the original image and no source lines. Missing anchors still fail.
The runtime report retains 1 unique/2 raw placement warnings and blockerIds:[1] because functional quality failed. It is not a runtime-clean pass. Attachment coverage remains bounded as recorded.
Text translation transport is deterministic fixture data, not a live provider or linguistic-quality evaluation.
No current runner SHA is substituted for the unarchived historical runner. No whole-pipeline performance or preferred-backend coverage claim.
The wordless page is manga-only and must be excluded from ordinary-image profile manifests.
